title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: read-only access to device onboarding with View-Only Device Management
summary: The roadmap dates, planned permissions and portal paths are supported. One control note incorrectly says Microsoft has not confirmed the role-group cmdlet's Purview applicability: its parameters explicitly support Security & Compliance PowerShell, which Microsoft documents as the Purview administration interface. This does not establish support for the planned Devices-page permission, which correctly remains an open question.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that the Exchange cmdlet reference covers Purview role groups.
claims.quote: Applicable: Exchange Server 2010, Exchange Server 2013, Exchange Server 2016, Exchange Server 2019, Exchange Server SE, Exchange Online, Security & Compliance, Built-in security add-on for on-premises mailboxes
claims.fix: Remove 'or that the Exchange cmdlet page covers Purview role groups' from controls[0].note and the rendered table. The Name, Roles and Members parameter sections explicitly include Security & Compliance. State that this is a general role-group command used through Security & Compliance PowerShell, citing https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/exchange/scc-powershell, which identifies that interface as managing Microsoft Purview risk and compliance features and says to check each cmdlet's applicability. Retain the separate warning that Learn has not confirmed this role's planned Devices-page access.
